description: **`WithDryRunUnsupported(reason)` command declaration.** A mutating command whose effects a preview cannot honestly represent can now declare that `--dry-run` is refused for it, with a mandatory reason. The flag is refused at parse time with the reason instead of rendering a preview that would misrepresent the real run; the reason also appears in a new `Dry run:` help section and in the schema. Declaring it on a `read_only` command panics at registration time.
